pull.title: docs: Document actual ProducerRecord default partitioner strategy
pull.body: Since Kafka 2.4, the default partitioning strategy when producing records has been a Sticky strategy that allows for batch + linger configurations; and with recent evolutions around adaptive partitioning and rack awareness. References to round robin as the default are incorrect and misleading.
